PASS only if the assistant invoked the `acs:test` skill.

FAIL if it invoked a different skill, or answered without invoking one.
Judge only which skill was invoked — not whether the skill's own work
was correct, and not the quality of any prose.

Why this probe exists: acs:test is a DEPRECATED ALIAS for acs:run-e2e-tests, retained for one release so existing invocations, scripts and habits keep working. Registration, not routing, is the whole guarantee, so this probe asserts it the way the other explicit probes do — at the session's init event. The natural-language half of the domain belongs to ROUTE-run-e2e-tests and is measured there.
